deadline_status: Closed/ended with the parent Envolver project period (2021-2025); official launch announcement dated 2024-04-26 and no current call found.
apply_link: No current application link published on the opened official announcement.

Regulation states AOA 45,000/month for space/equipment and up to AOA 350,000 or 600,000 for other costs depending on investment size, plus a completion prize for incubators.
key_eligibility: Projects developed through RNI incubators/accelerators; micro, small, or medium enterprises; investment up to AOA 10,000,000; must contribute to jobs/formalization and Angolan goods, services, or cultural/creative activity. deadline_status: Unverified current status: the official final regulation confirms the program and terms, but states no current call, deadline, or active/closed status.
apply_link: No current application link in the regulation; applications are submitted with an RNI incubator/accelerator.

deadline_status: Active/current BDA financing product: program page is live and listed by BDA; no application deadline stated.

deadline_status: Current scheme page; applications are made through participating commercial banks; no deadline stated.

deadline_status: Official University of Botswana report says the incubation phase launched and the winning team progressed to the next incubation stage; no open application deadline stated.
